headword: {早期退職|そうきたいしょく}

definitions.explanation: retirement from work before the standard retirement age, often with incentive packages

examples.japanese: {早期退職|そうきたいしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{早期退職|そうきたいしょく}{制度|せいど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}した→導入する：16055_dounyuusuru⟧。
examples.english: The company introduced an early retirement program.

examples.japanese: {早期退職|そうきたいしょく}⟦すれば→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{割増|わりまし}→割増：17087_warimashi⟧⟦{退職金|たいしょくきん}→退職金：07959_taishokukin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦もらえる→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: If you take early retirement, you can receive an enhanced severance package.

notes:
{早期退職|そうきたいしょく} refers to retiring from work before the standard retirement age, often with incentive packages.

FORMS:
⟦{早期|そうき}→早期：09568_souki⟧ (early stage) + ⟦{退職|たいしょく}→退職：04559_taishoku⟧ (retirement)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {早期退職|そうきたいしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to choose early retirement
- {早期退職|そうきたいしょく}{制度|せいど}: early retirement program
- {早期退職|そうきたいしょく}⟦{優遇|ゆうぐう}→優遇：17162_yuuguu⟧: early retirement incentives

RELATED WORDS:
- {希望退職|きぼうたいしょく}: voluntary retirement
- ⟦{定年退職|ていねんたいしょく}→定年退職：16450_teinentaishoku⟧: mandatory retirement
- ⟦{退職金|たいしょくきん}→退職金：07959_taishokukin⟧: severance pay
- ⟦{割増|わりまし}→割増：17087_warimashi⟧⟦{退職金|たいしょくきん}→退職金：07959_taishokukin⟧: enhanced severance

USAGE:
Often offered during corporate restructuring. Japan's standard retirement age is typically 60-65.
